Check-in Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Standard check-in time is 2:00 PM. Guests are required to present a valid government-issued photo ID and the booking confirmation at the reception. A refundable security deposit may be collected during check-in, depending on the room category. Early check-in is subject to room availability and hotel policies. Guests arriving before the standard check-in time may request luggage storage free of charge while waiting for their room.

Check-out Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Guests wishing to extend their stay should contact the Front Desk before check-out. Late check-out may be available based on occupancy and may incur additional charges. Before leaving, guests are requested to return the room key and settle any outstanding charges such as minibar usage, laundry, or room service.

Early Check-in Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Guests may request an early check-in from 11:00 AM onwards. If a room is available and has been prepared by housekeeping, early check-in will be provided free of charge. Requests are processed on a first-come, first-served basis. Guests arriving much earlier may use the hotel's lounge area and luggage storage facility until their room is ready.

Late Check-out Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Late check-out is available upon request and depends on room availability. Guests checking out between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM may be charged a partial room rate. Check-outs after 2:00 PM are generally charged as a full night's stay. Guests are advised to contact the Front Desk at least one day in advance to request a late check-out.

Reception & Concierge Services

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Front Desk operates 24 hours a day to assist guests with check-in, check-out, travel information, and general inquiries. Concierge services include restaurant reservations, local sightseeing recommendations, transportation arrangements, wake-up calls, and assistance with special guest requests. Staff members are available at all times to provide prompt support and ensure a comfortable stay.

Luggage Storage Service

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Guests may store their luggage securely at the reception before check-in or after check-out at no additional cost on the same day. Long-term luggage storage may be available upon request and is subject to space availability. The hotel recommends that guests avoid storing valuable items such as cash, jewellery, passports, or electronic devices in stored luggage.

Airport Pickup & Drop Service

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Airport transportation is available for guests upon prior reservation. Pick-up and drop-off services operate throughout the day and are charged according to the vehicle selected. Guests should provide their flight details at least 24 hours before arrival to ensure timely service. Hotel representatives will coordinate the pickup schedule and assist guests upon arrival.

Guest Complaint Resolution

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Guest satisfaction is our highest priority. Any concerns regarding room facilities, cleanliness, dining, or hotel services should be reported to the Front Desk immediately. The hotel aims to acknowledge complaints promptly and resolve most issues within a reasonable timeframe. If required, matters may be escalated to the Duty Manager for further assistance and resolution.

Lost & Found Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Items found within the hotel premises are recorded and securely stored by the housekeeping department. Guests who believe they have misplaced personal belongings should contact the Front Desk with a detailed description of the item. Unclaimed items are generally retained for 90 days before being disposed of in accordance with hotel policy.

Foreign Currency Exchange Service

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Limited foreign currency exchange services are available for registered hotel guests during reception operating hours. Exchange rates are based on the prevailing daily market rate and may vary. Guests are required to present valid identification while requesting this service. Major international currencies are accepted, subject to availability.

Deluxe Room Information

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Deluxe Room offers a comfortable stay with a king-size bed, air conditioning, a smart TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, tea and coffee-making facilities, and a work desk. Each room includes an attached bathroom with premium toiletries and a hairdryer. The room accommodates up to two adults and one child. Daily housekeeping is included in the room rate.

Executive Room Information

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Executive Rooms are designed for business and leisure travelers seeking additional comfort. These rooms feature a king-size bed, ergonomic workspace, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart TV, minibar, coffee machine, and city views. Guests staying in Executive Rooms also receive complimentary access to the Executive Lounge during operating hours.

Presidential Suite Information

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Presidential Suite is the hotel's premium accommodation, offering a spacious living room, master bedroom, dining area, luxury bathroom, and private balcony. Guests enjoy personalized check-in, complimentary airport transfers, daily breakfast, and priority concierge assistance. The suite is ideal for VIP guests, executives, and families seeking a luxury experience.

Room Amenities Guide

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Every guest room is equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a smart television, electronic safe, telephone, minibar, tea and coffee-making facilities, bottled drinking water, premium toiletries, fresh towels, and a hairdryer. Additional amenities such as an iron, ironing board, or extra pillows can be requested through housekeeping.

Housekeeping Schedule

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Daily housekeeping services are provided between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM. Guests who prefer not to be disturbed may activate the "Do Not Disturb" indicator outside their room. Additional cleaning requests or replenishment of towels and toiletries can be made by contacting housekeeping through the in-room telephone.

Linen & Towel Replacement Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Bed linens are replaced every third day during extended stays unless guests request otherwise. Fresh bath towels are provided daily. Guests wishing to support the hotel's sustainability program may reuse towels by hanging them on the towel rack. Towels placed on the floor will be replaced during housekeeping service.

Extra Bed Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Extra beds are available upon request for selected room categories and are subject to availability. Additional charges apply per night and include bedding and basic amenities. The hotel recommends requesting an extra bed during the reservation process to ensure availability before arrival.

Baby Crib Service

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Complimentary baby cribs are available for infants under two years of age, subject to availability. Guests are encouraged to request a crib while making their reservation or before arrival. The hotel provides clean bedding for every crib to ensure the comfort and safety of young children.

Mini Bar Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Each guest room includes a minibar stocked with beverages and snacks. Items consumed from the minibar are automatically charged to the guest's room account and are payable during check-out. Guests are requested not to restock or replace minibar items with outside products.

In-room Safe Instructions

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Every room is equipped with an electronic safety locker for storing valuables such as passports, cash, jewelry, and electronic devices. Guests are advised to set a personal PIN while using the safe. The hotel is not responsible for valuables left unsecured outside the in-room safe. For additional assistance, guests may contact the Front Desk.

Breakfast Timings

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Complimentary breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM at the Horizon Restaurant on the ground floor. The buffet includes Indian, Continental, and healthy breakfast options along with fresh juices, tea, and coffee. Guests are requested to carry their room key or breakfast coupon while entering the restaurant. Breakfast service concludes promptly at 10:30 AM.

Main Restaurant Timings

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Horizon Restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily. Lunch is available from 12:30 PM to 3:00 PM, while dinner is served between 7:00 PM and 10:30 PM. Reservations are recommended during weekends and public holidays. Smart casual attire is encouraged for all guests dining in the restaurant.

Room Service

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Room service is available 24 hours a day for all in-house guests. A selection of Indian, Continental, and international dishes can be ordered using the in-room telephone. Estimated delivery time is 25 to 40 minutes, depending on the order and occupancy. Additional service charges may apply for certain premium menu items.

Coffee Shop Information

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The hotel's coffee shop, Brew Lounge, is open daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Guests can enjoy freshly brewed coffee, tea, pastries, sandwiches, desserts, and light snacks. Complimentary Wi-Fi and comfortable seating make it an ideal place for informal meetings or relaxation throughout the day.

Rooftop Restaurant

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Skyline Rooftop Restaurant offers panoramic city views along with a fine dining experience. It operates daily from 6:30 PM to 11:00 PM. The menu features grilled specialties, seafood, Indian cuisine, and handcrafted desserts. Advance reservations are recommended, especially during weekends and festive seasons.

Bar & Lounge Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Horizon Lounge Bar is open from 5:00 PM to 12:00 Midnight. Guests must be 21 years or older to purchase or consume alcoholic beverages. Outside food and beverages are not permitted. The hotel reserves the right to refuse service to guests displaying inappropriate or disruptive behavior.

Kids Menu

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

A dedicated children's menu is available at the Horizon Restaurant and through room service. Popular options include mini pizzas, pasta, sandwiches, fruit bowls, fresh juices, and healthy snacks. Parents may request customized meals for children with dietary restrictions or allergies by informing the restaurant staff in advance.

Food Allergy Information

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Guests with food allergies or dietary restrictions are encouraged to inform the restaurant staff before placing an order. Menu items may contain allergens such as nuts, dairy, gluten, eggs, or seafood. The culinary team will make every reasonable effort to accommodate special dietary requirements while maintaining food safety standards.

Vegetarian & Vegan Options

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The hotel offers a variety of vegetarian and vegan dishes across all dining outlets. Guests can choose from salads, soups, plant-based curries, pasta, rice bowls, and dairy-free desserts. Customized vegan meals can also be prepared upon request. Please inform the restaurant staff of your dietary preferences before ordering.

Banquet Dining Services

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The hotel provides banquet dining services for weddings, conferences, corporate meetings, and private celebrations. Customized buffet and plated meal options are available to suit different event sizes and budgets. Guests planning an event should contact the Banquet Sales Team at least seven days in advance for menu planning and venue arrangements.

Swimming Pool Rules

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The outdoor swimming pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Guests are requested to shower before entering the pool. Children under 12 years of age must be accompanied by an adult at all times. Running, diving, and glass containers are not permitted in the pool area. Complimentary towels are available near the pool entrance.

Gym Rules & Timings

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The fitness center is open 24 hours for registered hotel guests. Guests are required to wear appropriate workout attire and athletic footwear while using the gym. Equipment should be cleaned after use with the sanitizing wipes provided. Guests under 16 years of age must be supervised by an adult.

Spa Services

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Serenity Spa operates daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Guests can choose from massages, facials, body treatments, and wellness therapies. Advance appointments are recommended to ensure availability. Guests are advised to arrive at least 15 minutes before their scheduled treatment.

Steam Room Guidelines

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The steam room is available daily from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Guests should limit each session to 15–20 minutes for maximum comfort. Individuals with heart conditions, high blood pressure, or other medical concerns are advised to consult a healthcare professional before using the facility.

Sauna Rules

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The sauna is available exclusively for hotel guests aged 18 years and above. Sessions should not exceed 20 minutes at a time. Guests are encouraged to stay hydrated before and after using the sauna. Food, beverages, and electronic devices are not permitted inside the sauna room.

Kids Play Area

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Kids Play Zone is open daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM and features indoor games, educational toys, and activity stations for children between 3 and 12 years of age. Parents or guardians are responsible for supervising their children while using the facility. Outside food is not permitted inside the play area.

Indoor Games Room

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Guests can enjoy a variety of indoor recreational activities including table tennis, carrom, chess, billiards, and board games. The Games Room is open daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Equipment should be returned after use, and guests are requested to maintain a quiet and respectful environment.

Outdoor Sports Activities

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The hotel offers outdoor recreational facilities including badminton, basketball, and jogging tracks. Sports equipment can be borrowed from the Recreation Desk during operating hours. Guests are encouraged to wear suitable sports attire and follow all posted safety instructions while using these facilities.

Yoga & Meditation Sessions

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Complimentary yoga and meditation sessions are conducted every morning from 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM in the Wellness Studio. Certified instructors guide participants through beginner-friendly exercises focused on relaxation, flexibility, and mindfulness. Prior registration at the Front Desk is recommended due to limited seating.

Weekend Entertainment Programs

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday evening, the hotel hosts live entertainment including music performances, cultural shows, and family-friendly activities. Events are generally scheduled between 7:00 PM and 10:00 PM in the central courtyard or banquet lawn. Guests can check the weekly activity schedule at the reception for event details.

Laundry Service

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Laundry services are available daily from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Guests may place their laundry in the designated laundry bag provided in the room and contact housekeeping for collection. Regular laundry is typically returned within 24 hours, while express service is available for an additional charge.

Dry Cleaning Service

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Professional dry cleaning services are available for delicate garments such as suits, dresses, and formal wear. Clothing collected before 10:00 AM is generally returned by the following evening. Charges vary depending on the garment type and are added to the guest's final bill.

Wi-Fi Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel for all registered guests. Guests can connect using the network GrandHorizon_Guest and enter the access credentials provided during check-in. For technical assistance or connectivity issues, guests may contact the Front Desk at any time.

Business Centre Services

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Business Centre is open daily from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Facilities include desktop computers, high-speed internet access, printing, scanning, photocopying, and meeting workstations. Guests requiring administrative assistance may request support from the Business Centre staff during operating hours.

Meeting & Conference Rooms

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The hotel offers fully equipped meeting rooms and conference halls suitable for business meetings, training sessions, and corporate events. Facilities include projectors, audio-visual equipment, wireless internet, and customizable seating arrangements. Advance booking is recommended to ensure availability.

Printing & Photocopy Services

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Printing, scanning, and photocopying services are available through the Business Centre. Guests may email their documents to the Business Centre or use the available workstations. Standard printing charges apply, while basic scanning services are provided free of charge for registered hotel guests.

Parking Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The hotel provides complimentary on-site parking for all registered guests throughout their stay. Parking spaces are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Dedicated parking is available for guests with disabilities and electric vehicles. The hotel recommends locking vehicles and avoiding leaving valuables inside parked cars

EV Charging Station

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Electric vehicle charging stations are available within the hotel's parking area. Guests may use the charging facility based on availability. Charging fees are calculated according to electricity consumption and are payable during check-out. Guests should contact the Front Desk to reserve a charging slot if required.

Taxi & Local Transport Booking

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The Concierge Desk can arrange taxis, airport transfers, car rentals, and local sightseeing transportation. Guests are encouraged to book transportation in advance during weekends and holidays. Fare estimates will be provided before confirming the reservation, and payment can be made directly to the service provider or added to the room bill where applicable.

Medical Assistance & First Aid

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Basic first aid assistance is available at the Front Desk at all times. In case of medical emergencies, the hotel can arrange immediate transportation to the nearest hospital or contact an on-call doctor. Guests requiring regular medication or special medical support are advised to inform the hotel during check-in for appropriate assistance.

Cancellation Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Guests may cancel their reservation up to 48 hours before the scheduled check-in date without any cancellation charges. Cancellations made within 48 hours of arrival may incur a one-night room charge. Refund processing timelines depend on the original payment method. Special promotional and non-refundable bookings are not eligible for cancellation.

Early Check-in Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Guests requesting an early check-in before the standard check-in time of 2:00 PM may be accommodated based on room availability. An additional charge of ₹1000 applies for approved early check-ins. Guests arriving significantly earlier are encouraged to use the luggage storage facility until their room is prepared.

Pet Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The hotel welcomes small domestic pets weighing up to 20 kg. A one-time cleaning fee of ₹1500 applies per stay. Pets must remain on a leash in public areas and should not be left unattended inside guest rooms. Owners are fully responsible for any damage or disturbance caused by their pets.

Pet Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Pets are not permitted anywhere on the hotel premises to maintain cleanliness and ensure the comfort of all guests. The only exception is for certified service animals, which are allowed with valid documentation. Guests traveling with pets are advised to contact nearby pet boarding facilities before arrival.

Noise & Quiet Hours Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

To ensure a peaceful stay for all guests, quiet hours are observed daily from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Guests are requested to keep television volumes low and avoid loud conversations or gatherings during this period. Repeated disturbances may result in warnings or further action by hotel management.

Visitor Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

Visitors are permitted between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM after registering at the Front Desk with a valid photo ID. Overnight visitors are not allowed unless officially added to the room reservation and applicable charges have been settled. Hotel management reserves the right to deny entry if security concerns arise.

Emergency Evacuation Procedure

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

In case of an emergency such as fire, earthquake, or any evacuation alert, guests should remain calm and immediately follow the illuminated emergency exit signs. Elevators should not be used during emergencies. Hotel staff will guide guests to the designated assembly area outside the building until further instructions are provided.

Breakfast Timings

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The breakfast buffet is available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM at the Horizon Restaurant. Guests are encouraged to arrive early during weekends to avoid waiting times. Breakfast service concludes promptly at 10:00 AM, after which the restaurant begins lunch preparations.

Swimming Pool Rules

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

The swimming pool operates daily from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Guests must wear appropriate swimwear while using the pool. Children below 14 years of age must be supervised by an adult. Pool towels are available at the Recreation Desk, and food or beverages are not permitted inside the pool area.

Parking Policy

Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites

On-site parking is available for hotel guests at a charge of ₹200 per vehicle per day. Parking spaces are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis and cannot be reserved in advance. Guests are requested to lock their vehicles and avoid leaving valuable belongings inside parked cars.

# corpus/ — Hotel Documents

**Owner: Lakshya**

## What this folder is

The hotel's documents live here: the knowledge the assistant answers from. About 60 short 
documents covering things like pool and gym hours, check-in and check-out rules, menus, and 
policies.

## How to fill it

See the full instructions in `retrieval/README.md` (Step 1). In short:
- Write ~60 short documents, one topic per file, as `.txt` or `.md`.
- Make them realistic and varied.
- Deliberately plant a few contradictions (e.g. one doc says the pool closes at 10 PM, 
  another says 9 PM) and keep a note of which ones, for a later experiment.

The index-building script reads every file in this folder, so anything you put here becomes 
part of the searchable knowledge.
